D-Luciferin (D-LH2) is the most used substrate for beetle luciferases in various bioluminescence applications. Here, we successfully synthesized six D-LH2 analogues including 5’,7’- dimethoxy-D-LH2, and 7’-methylnaphthol-D-LH2 as novel compounds. We...
